Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['In my department we discovered an abandoned sum of USD$22.3 Million (THEN TWO MILLION THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND U.S. DOLLARS).', 'WE RECENTLY DISCOVERED THAT TODAY THERE WERE 3 INCORRECT LOGIN ATTEMPTS TO YOUR ACCOUNT.', 'Therefore, our security commitment forces us to block your account temporarily until you verify your identity on our systems.', 'During our regularly scheduled account maintenance and verification procedures, we have detected a slight error in your account information.', 'eBay Customer Support has reviewed the case and made a final decision.', "To ensure your protection, we've now blocked access to your accounts.", 'Suspended Account noticed a sign in attempt from an usual location and device.', 'Your Account has been limited', 'Dear Customer, You Have One new security message.', 'We just noticed a fishing message on our system, and as a result of that, we have temporary stop all outgoing/incoming messages.', 'The Human Resources/Payroll Department has completed the final pay-stub changes for 2017 tax year.', 'This email is to confirm that you have successfully changed your profile.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'We are sorry to inform you that your last purchase has been cancelled for some security reasons we put your account on hold until we hear from you', 'Abbey National is adding a layer of security to better protect the privacy of your account.', 'Your PayPal account has been limited!', 'After a thorough check, we detected irregular activity on your account.', 'Your Apple ID number # 100160027129 has been disabled for safety reasons.', 'During our regular scheduled account maintenance and verification process, we were unable to verify your account information.', "To ensure you are always protected, we've placed your account on restriction statues due to Multiple Log-in attempt error.", 'We have temporarily suspended your account and your access to online banking and will be restricted if you fail to update.', 'You are at 90% of the maximum space allowed in your Mailbox !', 'USAA was unable to process your request', 'We are contacting you to remind you that our Account Review Team identified some unusual activity in your account.', 'For security reasons, we have temporarily Flagged your Online Access and your access to online banking will be restricted if you fail to re-confirm your membership details.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:

    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
